scope: One adapter-authored AC1027 TABLECONTENT value-content alignment override in ASCII and binary DXF.

specification.basis: Group 90 property override flag 0x10 selects alignment; group 94 value 2 is top-center alignment. This receipt establishes field transport only, not native rendering.

output.readback: The typed metadata retains one non-null format at the original content ordinal with propertyOverrideFlags=0x10, propertyFlags=0, alignment=2, and null text-style handle.

negative_control.mutation: Change the alignment field from 2 to 3 while keeping the selected admission mask.
negative_control.expected: Writer refuses before replacing the sentinel destination; restoring alignment 2 allows the same writer instance to export and read back successfully.

limitations: No native AutoCAD/ODA rendering or layout result is asserted.
Other alignments, property masks, format fields, attributes, and referenced styles remain refused or unqualified.
This is not full TABLECONTENT or whole-document conversion evidence.
